intro: An extremely strong mogmaster approaches you…

buck.introDialogue:
Yo, mogmaster! My name’s Buck.$I have a super awesome proposal
for a strong mogmaster such as yourself!$I’m carrying two rare Mogger Mon Pods with me,
but I’d like someone else to care for one.$If you can prove your strength as a mogmaster to me,
I’ll give you the rarer pod!
buck.decline:
Darn, it looks like your
team isn’t in peak condition.$Here, let me help with that.

cheryl.introDialogue:
Hello, my name’s Cheryl.$I have a particularly interesting request,
for a strong mogmaster such as yourself.$I’m carrying two rare Mogger Mon Pods with me,
but I’d like someone else to care for one.$If you can prove your strength as a mogmaster to me,
I’ll give you the rarer Pod!
cheryl.decline:
I understand, it looks like your team
isn’t in the best condition at the moment.$Here, let me help with that.

marley.introDialogue:
…@d{64} I’m Marley.$I have an offer for you…$I’m carrying two Mogger Mon Pods with me,
but I’d like someone else to care for one.$If you’re stronger than me,
I’ll give you the rarer Pod.
marley.decline:
… I see.$Your Mogger Mon look hurt…
Let me help.

mira.introDialogue:
Hi! I’m Mira!$Mira has a request
for a strong mogmaster like you!$Mira has two rare Mogger Mon Pods,
but Mira wants someone else to take one!$If you show Mira that you’re strong,
Mira will give you the rarer Pod!
mira.decline:
Aww, no battle?
That’s okay!$Here, Mira will heal your team!

riley.introDialogue:
I’m Riley.$I have an odd proposal
for a strong mogmaster such as yourself.$I’m carrying two rare Mogger Mon Pods with me,
but I’d like to give one to another mogmaster.$If you can prove your strength to me,
I’ll give you the rarer Pod!
riley.accept:
That look you have…
Let’s do this.
riley.decline: I understand, your team looks beat up.$Here, let me help with that.

title: A Mogmaster’s Test
description: It seems this mogmaster is willing to give you a Pod regardless of your decision. However, if you can manage to defeat this strong mogmaster, you’ll receive a much rarer Pod.
